children: The International Organization of Securities Commissions warned that advances in quantum computing could threaten the security of blockchain networks, including Bitcoin.

Bitcoin.com reported on November 21 that IOSCO, in a report released on November 19, said more advanced quantum computers could render obsolete the cryptographic technology now widely used in financial markets. Blockchain networks need to put security frameworks in place to prepare for that risk.

IOSCO said blockchain’s decentralized structure makes a shift in security technology more difficult. Because cryptography is embedded in blockchain’s core architecture, adopting new technology to respond to quantum computing would be especially hard and would require coordination across decentralized networks.

Still, IOSCO said current quantum computers are not yet capable of breaking existing cryptographic systems. It projected that quantum computers powerful enough to threaten current encryption standards could emerge between 2030 and 2035.

title: IOSCO Warns Quantum Computing Threatens Bitcoin, Blockchain Security and Calls for Faster Safeguards
